newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault, Finland's Sisu form venture.
newsitem.headline: Renault, Finland's Sisu form venture.

text.p: French carmaker Renault said its Renault V.I. truck manufacturing division and Oy Sisu AB of Finland had signed an agreement on Monday in Helsinki to form a joint venture that would take up Sisu's truck dealer network.

Under the terms of the deal, whose broad lines were laid out last June, the new 50-50 venture, RS Hansa Auto Oy, will market Renault and Sisu trucks in Finland and provide services for both lines. It will employ 280 people.
"For Renault V.I., cooperation with Sisu is part of a commercial development strategy in northern Europe based on a solid sales network in Finland," Renault said in a statement.
State-owned Sisu has around 20 dealers in Finland.
Under the deal, Renault will also provide components, including gearboxes and cabs for Sisu.
The French company previously said the venture may extend to other Nordic countries, but that Renault did not envisage taking up any part of Sisu's truck production activities.
Renault said it would acquire 50 percent of the venture's capital at the end of February. A spokeswoman declined to give the terms.
